name: Datumline Piercers
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production 2D fantasy strategy game animated sprite source. True transparent RGBA background. Exactly four full-body poses of ONE original upgraded Brasshollow creature in a perfectly regular 2x2 grid with equal square cells, wide clear transparent gutters. Painterly richly textured fantasy unit art, weathered brass and soot-black iron, warm directional light. Right-facing three-quarter camera; same identity, design, equipment, proportions and scale in all four cells. Full body and all weapons visible with generous 8% margin EACH cell. Same planted feet/paws positions in every cell. Four genuinely articulated idle keyframes reading row-major, visibly different joint and equipment angles; no static duplicate cutouts. No text, caption, watermark, gridlines, checkerboard, environment, scenery, floor or platform.  CRITICAL LAYOUT: make sheet square 1536x1536. Each of 4 cells is768x768. Draw characters substantially SMALLER within cells: subject occupies at most 70% of cell height and width, leave a full100px EMPTY margin on ALL sides of each subject. Nothing may touch outer image boundary or central seams.Creature Datumline Piercers. Narrow masked brass-armored precision gunner with long steel arbalest on shoulder support, conspicuous tall forked calibrated sight and brass measuring rail, slender leather armored legs, long angular helmet. Idle: 1 long arbalest low across waist; 2 both elbows flex weapon raises to chest; 3 left hand adjusts tall forked sight while right holds trigger grip; 4 left hand returns to barrel support and muzzle lowers halfway. Ensure whole crossbow including far muzzle has wide empty margins.
reference_use: Original generation based on approved unit upgrade design brief.
